## Import

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(plotgardener)

setwd("~/gitcode/DNAm")
`%nin%` = negate(`%in%`) 
```

## Munge

### Endophenotypes

```{r}
cog.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Assessment_Analyses/ADSP_ADNI_Cognition_Dec2023/ADSP_PHC_COGN_Dec2023.csv")
fluid_bm <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADSP-PHC/Biospecimen_Analyses/ADSP_PHC_CSF_Dec2023.csv")

dx_bl <- filter(cog.merge, PHC_Visit == 1) %>% 
    mutate(
    dx_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Diagnosis == "1" ~ "CN", 
      PHC_Diagnosis == "2" ~ "MCI", 
      PHC_Diagnosis == "3" ~ "AD", 
     ), 
    dx_bl = fct_relevel(dx_bl, "CN", "MCI", "AD"), 
  ) %>%
    select(RID, dx_bl)


```

### Methylation

```{r}
## Mythylation
map.raw <- readxl::read_xlsx("resources/ADNI/ADNI_DNA_Methylation_SampleAnnotation_20170530.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(Edate = as.Date(Edate))
clocks.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/adni_epiclocks_240826.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) 

dnam.raw <- map.raw %>%
  dplyr::select(barcodes, RID, Phase,  Edate, DateDrawn, PlateNumber, Array) %>%
  rename(Phase_methy = Phase,  Edate_methy = Edate, DateDrawn_methy = DateDrawn) %>%
  arrange(RID, Edate_methy, PlateNumber) %>%
  left_join(clocks.raw, by = 'barcodes') 

dnam <- dnam.raw %>% 
  group_by(RID, Edate_methy) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice(1:3)%>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Age)

```

### Telomeres
- TL_BP_ADJ: Telomere length / Single copy gene (T/S) ratio of DNA from blood, adjusted for logistical confounders

```{r}
## Telomere Ration
ts.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/TS_RATIO_ADJ_23Aug2024.csv")

ts <- ts.raw %>% 
  arrange(RID, EXAM_DATE) %>%
  group_by(RID, EXAM_DATE) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice(1:3) %>%
  ungroup() 
  
```

### APOE

```{r}
## APOE 
apoe <- apoe.raw %>%
  unite(apoe_geno, c(APGEN1, APGEN2), sep = "") %>%
  mutate(
    apoe = case_when(
      apoe_geno == "22" ~ "e2+", 
      apoe_geno == "23" ~ "e2+", 
      apoe_geno == "24" ~ "e4+", 
      apoe_geno == "33" ~ "e3/e3", 
      apoe_geno == "34" ~ "e4+", 
      apoe_geno == "44" ~ "e4+", 
    ), 
    apoe = fct_relevel(apoe, "e3/e3"), 
  ) %>%
   fastDummies::dummy_cols(select_columns = "apoe", remove_most_frequent_dummy = T) %>%
  rename(apoe_e2 = `apoe_e2+`, apoe_e4 = `apoe_e4+`)
  
 
```

## Merge 
```{r}
## APOE 
tl.merge <- ts %>% select(RID, EXAM_DATE, TL_BP_ADJ)
dnam.merge <- dnam %>% select(RID, Edate_methy, CausAge, DamAge, AdaptAge)
apoe.merge <- apoe %>% select(RID, apoe_geno, apoe, apoe_e2, apoe_e4)
cog.merge <- cog.raw %>% 
  filter(RID %in% tl.merge$RID) %>%
  select(RID, VISCODE2, EXAMDATE, PHC_Visit, PHC_Sex, PHC_Education, PHC_Ethnicity, PHC_Race, PHC_Age_Cognition, PHC_Diagnosis, 
         PHC_MEM, PHC_EXF, PHC_LAN, PHC_VSP)

 
genetics <- tl.merge %>% 
  left_join(dnam.merge, by = c("RID", 'EXAM_DATE' = 'Edate_methy'))  %>% 
  left_join(apoe.merge, by = c("RID")) 

genetics_bl <- genetics %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(EXAM_DATE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    z_tl_bl = scale(TL_BP_ADJ)[,1] 
  ) %>%
  select(RID, tl_bl = TL_BP_ADJ, z_tl_bl, causage_bl = CausAge)

## Might need to filter this to omics bl
mean_age <- filter(cog.merge, PHC_Visit == 1) %>% summarise(age = mean(PHC_Age_Cognition)) %>% pull(age)

adni <- cog.merge %>%
  # left_join(dx_bl, by = c("RID")) %>%
  # left_join(genetics_bl, by = c("RID")) %>%
  left_join(genetics, by = c("RID", 'EXAMDATE' = "EXAM_DATE")) %>%
  mutate(
    age_c = PHC_Age_Cognition - mean_age, 
    sex = ifelse(PHC_Sex == 1, "Male", "Female")
  ) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate(
    dx_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit) ~ PHC_Diagnosis
      ), 
     tl_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(TL_BP_ADJ)]) ~ TL_BP_ADJ
      ),
    causage_bl = case_when(
      PHC_Visit == min(PHC_Visit[!is.na(CausAge)]) ~ CausAge
      ),
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
   dx_bl = case_when(
     dx_bl == 1 ~ "CN",
     dx_bl == 2 ~ "MCI",
     dx_bl == 3 ~ "AD",
   ),
   dx_bl = fct_relevel(dx_bl, "CN", "MCI", "AD"), 
   z_tl_bl = scale(tl_bl)[,1]
  ) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  fill(dx_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(tl_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(causage_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(z_tl_bl, .direction = "down") %>%
  fill(apoe, .direction = "updown") %>%
  fill(apoe, .direction = "down") %>%
  filter(!is.na(apoe)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CausAge)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(
    educ = PHC_Education
  )


```


```{r}

library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

fitlmer.00 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ age_c + (age_c  | RID), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.00)

fitlmer.01 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ age_c + sex + educ + apoe + dx_bl + (age_c  | RID), REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.01)

fitlmer.02 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ age_c + sex + educ + apoe + z_tl_bl + causage_bl + (age_c  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.02)

fitlmer.03 <- lmer(PHC_VSP ~ age_c + sex + educ + apoe*age_c + z_tl_bl*age_c + causage_bl*age_c + (age_c  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.03)

fitlmer.04 <- lmer(PHC_MEM ~ age_c + sex + educ + z_tl_bl*apoe*age_c + (age_c  | RID), 
                   REML = FALSE, control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), data = adni)
summary(fitlmer.04)


fitlmer.05 <- lmer(
  PHC_MEM ~ age_c + sex + educ + apoe * age_c + 
    TL_BP_ADJ * age_c + CausAge * age_c + 
    (age_c + TL_BP_ADJ + CausAge | RID), 
  REML = FALSE, 
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"), 
  data = adni
)

summary(fitlmer.05)
```
